LiH has no retained triples. The small H2 rotation defect is reproduced by native gradients and controlled by the individual PAO-pair screen. Nonplanar Boys/PM water-H2 and Boys ammonia-H2 add frozen-core off-diagonal pairs, distinct triplets and nonzero unequal-rank couplings with individual PAO-pair screening off. Native reference stencils must preserve the parent branch. General production scope is not validated.
blockers: Full screened matrices cover selected fragment and nonplanar molecular fixtures, including distinct-index triplets, unequal TNO ranks and frozen-core off-diagonal pairs; arbitrary molecule/threshold robustness and behavior near discrete parent-selection boundaries remain unvalidated.
Public Hessian delivery and its supported-input contract remain unimplemented; the current mixed-input harness uses dense AO tensors with AO Schwarz and Fock screens off.
Rotational screening accuracy, equilibrium vibrations and end-to-end scaling remain unvalidated.
record.functional_scope: The gradient model now includes eliminated SC-MP2 and dipole estimates with analytic gradients. Their mixed correction kernels are tested in screened_corrections.py. Screened first PNOs, coupled LMP2, final PNOs and both PNO-loss curvatures are tested separately in screened_final_pno.py. Screened CCSD residual and TNO/triples molecular inputs have selected block validation in screened_ccsd_mixed.py and screened_triples_mixed.py. Complete screened columns are tested against native analytic gradients in screened_column.py. Complete unsymmetrized screened matrices are tested separately in screened_matrix.py with a PAO-screen rotation control in screened_rotation.py and additional molecular coverage in screened_molecules.py. Conditioned Coulomb inverse response and native first-pivot roundoff are corrected without changing derivative equations or acceptance thresholds. Public analytic Hessian routing and broader production validation remain outstanding.
